title: Apple Updates iMac and MacBook Pro With M6 Chip
excerpt: Apple has updated its iMac and entry-level MacBook Pro models, equipping them with the new M6 processor and advanced connectivity features.
body_html:
Apple has announced updates to its iMac and entry-level MacBook Pro lineup. The refreshed devices are now powered by the new M6 chip, offering upgraded processing capabilities for users.

Alongside the performance upgrade, the new computers feature the N1 chip, which introduces support for Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 connectivity standards. The hardware updates bring the latest wireless technology and processing power to Apple's desktop and portable computer offerings.
